updated: Written from the owner's own list of commands. No date is recorded here because none was given.

gate: Every command except the setup group only runs in the game once a Rust server is linked and its connection has been tested.

commands.name: setup
commands.why: Administrator or Manage Server on this Discord.
commands.panel: A three-step panel: roles, log channels, then the Rust server details.
commands.summary: Sets the bot up for this Discord: your staff roles, your log channels, and the Rust servers it looks after. Nothing else on this page runs in the game until a server is linked and its connection has been tested.

subcommands.name: server
subcommands.summary: Opens three steps: 1) Roles (Owner, Co-Owner, Head Admin, Admin, Moderator, Linked), 2) Logging channels (create them or pick your own), 3) your Rust server's name, IP, RCON port and password. The connection is tested before anything is saved. Needs Administrator or Manage Server.
notes: The connection is tested before anything is saved, so a wrong password is refused rather than stored.
Owner and Linked are the two roles marked required; Co-Owner, Head Admin, Admin and Moderator can be left blank.
Each server you add takes one of the three server slots.

subcommands.name: view
subcommands.summary: Show your roles, servers (Connected or Offline) and log channels.

subcommands.name: remove
subcommands.summary: Remove one Rust server, or wipe the whole bot setup for this Discord.

subcommands.name: edit
subcommands.summary: Change a server's IP, RCON port or password.

subcommands.name: refresh
subcommands.summary: Force a reconnect of a server's RCON connection.

commands.name: kits
commands.who: KITMANAGER for grab and config; the staff roles you set for the rest
commands.why: A linked Rust server, plus the KITMANAGER role for grab and config.
commands.panel: The kits panel: binds, cooldowns, roles and locks, up to three kits per emote.
commands.summary: Emote Kits: the kit names the bot reads from the server, the binds that give them, their cooldowns and the roles allowed to use them.

subcommands.name: grab
subcommands.summary: KITMANAGER. Copies the real kit names from the Rust server.

subcommands.name: config
subcommands.summary: KITMANAGER. Opens the kits panel where you add, edit, remove and view binds with cooldowns, roles and up to 3 kits per emote; Lock Kits; Emote Guide.
notes: Up to three kits per emote.
Binds carry their own cooldown and role.

subcommands.name: give
subcommands.summary: Give a kit to a gamertag or a linked Discord user.

subcommands.name: refresh
subcommands.summary: Clear kit cooldowns for one user, one kit, all linked users or all kits.

subcommands.name: authspawn
subcommands.summary: Give a kit to everyone in an Auth Group (User, VIP, Moderator, Admin, Owner) each time they respawn. One kit per group.

subcommands.name: build
subcommands.summary: Kit Studio: build a kit, import an install code or choose from 18 pre-made kits.

subcommands.name: add
subcommands.summary: Install a kit from a Base64 Kit Install Code.
